name: read a board state from an image
definition: parse a rendered board image into a grid of occupied and empty intersections with correct stone ownership.
failure_mode: a mis-detected occupancy breaks the check.

name: read a neural-network checkpoint and a byte-pair vocabulary from c
definition: interpret a serialized model checkpoint and a byte-pair-encoding vocabulary so the parameters and token mappings become usable with no dependency.
failure_mode: mis-parsing the checkpoint or the vocabulary produces wrong tokens.
